description: This PHP source file defines and registers SOAP API functions for syncing relationship data, retrieving modified entries, and getting attendee lists within SuiteCRM. It includes validation, database queries, XML serialization, and external function references related to the CRM's SOAP interface.

methods.name: sync_get_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves a list of relationship records modified within a date range, supporting pagination and format options.

methods.name: get_modified_entries
methods.description: Fetches modified records of a specified module and returns serialized XML.

methods.name: get_attendee_list
methods.description: Retrieves attendee information for Meetings or Calls as XML, Base64 encoded.
